protocol.title: Automated Microfluidic System for Dynamic Stimulation and Tracking of Single Cells
protocol.platform: Large-scale integrated microfluidics (LSIM); two-layer PDMS valve-based chip
cell_lines: Murine LysM-GFP granulocyte-macrophage progenitors (GMPs) from C57BL/6J bone marrow
Murine embryonic stem cells line R1 (ERKKTR reporter)
protocol.objective: Long-term culture, dynamic cytokine stimulation, and single-cell time-lapse tracking of nonadherent hematopoietic progenitor cells and adherent murine ESCs using diffusion-based media exchange without displacement of individual cells

layers: Flow layer: PDMS, channel height 25 um; fabricated on SU-8 3025 master on 4-in. silicon wafer
Control layer: PDMS, channel height 25 um; AZ-50XT deposited at valve positions for parabolic surfaces
Coverslip bonded to underside of flow layer

media_reservoirs.exchange_mechanism: Fickian diffusion only; no direct flow into culture area

peristaltic_pump.function: Accurate fluid manipulation and cell seeding

device.gui: Custom MATLAB GUI for experimental scripting and valve control

environmental_control.humidity_source: 100 mL water absorbed by sodium polyacrylate (Sigma-Aldrich)

surface_functionalization.hematopoietic_progenitors: Fibronectin, 150 ng/mL (Merck KGaA), 3 h or overnight
surface_functionalization.embryonic_stem_cells: E-Cadherin, 150 ng/mL (Merck KGaA), 3 h or overnight

chip_validation.diffusion_calibrant: Rhodamine-conjugated Dextran, 40 kDa, 300 uM (comparable size to cytokines)

cell_media.GMPs_permissive: Stem-Span SFEM (StemCell Technologies) + 1% pen/strep + 10% FCS + 100 ng/mL SCF + 10 ng/mL IL3 + 10 ng/mL IL6 (all cytokines from Peprotech)
cell_media.GMPs_MCSF: Stem-Span SFEM + 1% pen/strep + 10% FCS + 20 ng/mL M-CSF (Peprotech)
cell_media.GMPs_antibody_staining: Anti-F4/80-APC antibody (clone BM8, eBioscience), 0.2 mg/mL at 1:10,000 dilution added to all M-CSF media
cell_media.muESC_self_renewing: DMEM (Gibco) + 10% FCS11 (PAA) + 1000 U/mL leukemia inhibitory factor (Lif, CellGS)
cell_media.muESC_FGF1_stimulation: 10 ng/mL recombinant mouse FGF1 (R&D Systems) in starvation medium

cell_seeding_hardware.tubing: PEEK tubing, 25 cm length, inner diameter 65 um
cell_seeding_hardware.vessel: Pressurized microcentrifuge tube connected to first inlet

GMPs.lineage_depletion_beads: Streptavidin Roti-MagBeads (Carl Roth AG), EasySep magnet (Stem Cell Technologies)
GMPs.bone_marrow_preparation: 4 C mortar; 40 um nylon mesh strainer (Becton Dickinson AG)

steps.name: Chip priming
steps.notes: PBS forced through all channels under pressure via liquid supply lines while outlet valves remain closed. Expels air; wets all surfaces prior to functionalization.

steps.name: Surface functionalization
steps.followed_by: Extensive PBS wash then cell culture media equilibration
steps.notes: Fibronectin for GMP experiments; E-Cadherin for muESC experiments. BioScript does not distinguish surface reagent identity at compiler level.

steps.name: Chip validation - bead displacement test
steps.notes: Beads pre-treated with 0.1% Triton-X to prevent aggregation. Displacement <2 um confirms absence of direct flow in culture chambers during media exchange.

steps.name: GMP seeding
steps.notes: Cells loaded via pressurized microcentrifuge tube through 65 um ID PEEK tubing. Peristaltic pump enables precise chamber-by-chamber deposition.

steps.name: Baseline culture in permissive SCF/IL3/IL6 media
steps.flow_switching: alternating left/right reservoir fill to prevent direct flow
steps.notes: Proliferation and cell cycle length comparable to Ibidi VI channel slides (paper Figs. S1A, S1B). Steady state per reservoir reached within 10 min of each 30-min switching cycle.

steps.name: In-culture continuous antibody staining of live cells
steps.notes: Antibody continuously present in diffusion media throughout M-CSF culture phase. Fluorescence signal detectable on differentiated cells confirms macrophage lineage commitment.

steps.name: Overnight starvation
steps.notes: Synchronises ERK baseline activity across all cells before FGF1 stimulation.

steps.name: Dynamic FGF1 stimulation (3 oscillation cycles)
steps.notes: 5 s FGF1 pulse into left reservoir; 32 min diffusion incubation; 2 s starvation wash into right reservoir; 15 min dilution incubation. Gradients last max 20 min per exchange. Each oscillation cycle uses freshly dispensed reagent variables (BioScript single-assignment constraint).

flow_switching_strategy.description: Alternating left/right reservoir fill prevents cross-chamber pressure-driven flow
flow_switching_strategy.left_reservoir_fill: Left-side valves open; right-side valves closed; fresh media flows into left reservoir
flow_switching_strategy.right_reservoir_fill: Right-side valves open; left-side valves closed; mirrors left fill to complete exchange cycle
flow_switching_strategy.seeding_valves: Remain closed during all culture phases
flow_switching_strategy.mass_transfer_law: Fick's Law through 50 um diffusion port

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: Chip priming, surface functionalization, bead validation, GMP seeding, baseline + M-CSF culture, muESC seeding, starvation, FGF1 oscillation

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: All durations in s (seconds) or m (minutes); h token not supported
bioscript_compiler_notes.single_assignment_constraint: BioScript forbids reuse of a consumed variable as a mix operand. Each flow-switch cycle and each media repeat requires a freshly dispensed named variable (e.g. permissiveMedia2, mcsfMedia2, selfRenewMedia2/3, starvationMedia2, mcsfAb2, permissiveBase2).
bioscript_compiler_notes.mix_abstraction: mix represents valve-controlled reservoir fill events and diffusive equilibration, not physical droplet-level mixing. No direct flow enters culture chambers.
